M-VT0316_Skincare_Set___Omni_Flash_1_1__.title: VT0316. Skincare Set — Omni Flash 1.1 'Video-to-Video Scene Editing' System (#1)
M-VT0316_Skincare_Set___Omni_Flash_1_1__.summary: MODE ROUTER + INPUT PREP Mode: Video-to-Video Scene Editing.
M-VT0316_Skincare_Set___Omni_Flash_1_1__.pipeline: prompt → reference-image-input → image-input-multi → video-input → 2× text-gen → image-gen → video-reference → text-gen → video-edit → 2× text-gen → video-edit → upscaler → download

requires.name: Skincare Set — anchor image (if the mode uses one)
Source video (if the mode edits one)

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Mode Router selects 'Video-to-Video Scene Editing': add, remove, or replace an object or element within existing footage while the rest of the scene remains untouched → Input Prep (Nano Banana Pro pre-cleans or generates any needed reference/anchor images) → Omni Flash 1.1 executes the mode's native generation/edit call with correctly structured inputs (frameImages / referenceImages / source video as required) → World-Knowledge Consistency Critic (does the result respect physics, scene logic, and the world-knowledge grounding Omni Flash brings beyond raw photorealism?) → Repair via a follow-up Interactions-API turn (conversational edit) rather than a full regeneration when the mode supports it → Deliver at draft (360p) then promote to 1080p/4K once approved → Package.
STAGE 1 — MODE ROUTER + INPUT PREP Mode: Video-to-Video Scene Editing. Wire only the inputs this mode actually consumes — text brief, one anchor image, up to five references, or an existing clip.
STAGE 2 — INPUT PREP (NANO BANANA PRO) Pre-cleans or generates any anchor and reference frames the mode requires.
STAGE 3 — OMNI FLASH 1.1 EXECUTION The mode's native call. The text-only lane uses a prompt-only video-gen node; the reference lane conditions on the anchor; the edit lane consumes the source video.

STAGE 4 — WORLD-KNOWLEDGE CONSISTENCY CRITIC Does the result respect physics, scene logic and the world knowledge Omni Flash brings beyond raw photorealism? Repair via a follow-up edit turn, not a full regeneration.
STAGE 5 — DRAFT THEN PROMOTE Review at draft resolution, then promote the approved cut to delivery.

M-VT0418_Real_Footage_Character_Object_I.title: VT0418. Real-Footage Character/Object Insert System #8
M-VT0418_Real_Footage_Character_Object_I.summary: INGESTION A few real seconds of the user's own footage plus the character or object reference to insert.
M-VT0418_Real_Footage_Character_Object_I.pipeline: video-input → reference-image-input → video-analyzer → 3× video-frame-extract → text-gen → video-edit → 3× text-gen → video-edit → download

requires.name: Real footage — the user's own clip

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Scene Forensics reads the real footage's lighting, camera motion, and spatial layout → Insert Director specifies a character/object to add, its entry point, and its behavior, matched to the scene's real lighting direction and perspective → Omni Flash 1.1 video-to-video generates the insert with the source footage as structural/lighting reference, preserving the real background exactly → Integration Critic (does the inserted element cast correct shadows, match perspective, and hold up under a 'play it again' rewatch?) → Repair on any integration seam → Package.
STAGE 1 — INGESTION A few real seconds of the user's own footage plus the character or object reference to insert.
STAGE 2 — INSERT DIRECTOR Specifies what enters, where it enters, how it behaves, and how it matches the real scene's light direction and perspective.
STAGE 3 — OMNI FLASH 1.1 VIDEO-TO-VIDEO INSERT The source footage is the structural and lighting reference; the real background is preserved exactly.
STAGE 4 — INTEGRATION CRITIC + SEAM REPAIR Correct shadows, matched perspective, and does it hold up on a second watch?

M-VT0455_Reading_Glasses___Conversationa.title: VT0455. Reading Glasses — Conversational Edit-Refinement Loop (#2)
M-VT0455_Reading_Glasses___Conversationa.summary: BASE STATE Either an uploaded clip of the Reading Glasses or a generated base.
M-VT0455_Reading_Glasses___Conversationa.pipeline: video-input → reference-image-input → prompt → video-edit → text-gen → video-edit → text-gen → video-edit → text-gen → video-edit → 3× text-gen → video-edit → download

requires.name: Base video — uploaded or previously generated

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Base Generation produces or accepts the starting video → Edit-Request Parser converts each natural-language note ('make the lighting warmer', 'swap the background to a kitchen', 'change the camera to a low angle') into a structured Interactions-API turn → Omni Flash 1.1 applies each edit conversationally, preserving everything not mentioned in that turn → Turn-by-Turn Diff Critic confirms only the requested change occurred (no unintended drift elsewhere in frame) → Repair (re-issue the turn with tighter scoping) on any unintended drift → Final-state Package once the director approves the accumulated edits.
STAGE 1 — BASE STATE Either an uploaded clip of the Reading Glasses or a generated base. Every turn below edits the accumulated state, not the original.
STAGE 2 — EDIT-REQUEST PARSER + SEQUENTIAL TURNS Each natural-language note becomes one scoped Interactions-style turn. Everything not mentioned in a turn must survive that turn untouched.
STAGE 3 — TURN-BY-TURN DIFF CRITIC Confirms only the requested change occurred in each turn — unintended drift anywhere else in frame is the failure this stage exists to catch.

N-041_sixty_second_six_clips.title: 60-Second Film: 6 x 10s clips merged into one long-form spot
N-041_sixty_second_six_clips.summary: INPUTS Product, character and world references plus the written brief.
N-041_sixty_second_six_clips.pipeline: reference-image-input → character-input → background-input → prompt → 8× text-gen → 6× video-reference → video-concat → 2× text-gen → lyria-3 → merge-audio-video → text-gen → video-subtitle → download
notes: STAGE 1 — INPUTS Product, character and world references plus the written brief. Leave any input you do not need empty.
STAGE 2 — STRATEGY Turns a loose brief into a hard campaign spine: one job, one tension, one through-line device, locked look.
STAGE 3 — THE 60s SCRIPT Written as one continuous film that happens to be cut at the 10s and 20s marks — that is what makes the three clips join invisibly.
STAGE 4 — 6 x 10s CLIPS One writer and one generator per segment. Each writer reads the whole script and extracts only its own segment, carrying the handoff frame from its neighbour.
STAGE 5 — ASSEMBLY 6 clips concatenated in order into the finished 60-second film.
